title: Building a Sustainable Future in Chemical Engineering
session_title: Building a Sustainable Future in Chemical Engineering
abstract: In today's dynamic market, the demand for sustainable processes is ever-increasing, pushing the boundaries of traditional engineering. Aveva Process Simulation presents an innovative, integrated platform that empowers industries to design sustainable processes at the speed the market demands, all while paving the way towards a circular and eco-conscious world. Join this workshop to learn more about AVEVA's innovative solutions in process simulation and XR technology that are driving sustainability and operational efficiency simultaneously. These advanced tools empower industries to meet the ever-evolving demands of the market while actively contributing to the global pursuit of sustainable and environmentally responsible processes.
